title: Field-linear module cohomology, pullback and external cup product
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, and $F,G$ sheaves of modules over $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Regard each module sheaf as a sheaf of $k$-vector spaces by restricting the action on an open $U$ along $k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. Write $H_k^n(X,F)$ for the cohomology of $F$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] with scalars restricted along $k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$. For a morphism $a:Y\to X$ over $k$, define the canonical cohomology pullback $H_k^n(X,F)\to H_k^n(Y,a^*F)$ using exact inverse image on sheaves of $k$-vector spaces and the coefficient map adjoint to the unit $F\to a_*a^*F$ of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Define $H_k^p(X,F)\times H_k^q(X,G)\to H_k^{p+q}(X,F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}G)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] by transporting the Yoneda cup product on Ext from the constant sheaf $k$ along the canonical injective-resolution comparison, then applying the coefficient map induced by $s\otimes_k t\mapsto s\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}t$. For $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, modules $F$ on $X$ and $G$ on $Y$, define the external cup product on $X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product] as projection pullbacks followed by this cup product. For a commutative square, the pullback-composition comparison is the unique isomorphism of left adjoints compatible with the canonical tensor-pullback units. The external-tensor coefficient comparison is the tensor-pullback comparison followed by the two composition comparisons. All coefficient maps on cohomology are the maps of the recorded derived functor.

proof.text: Definition repair (partial): bundle the ring map k to global sections as scalarUnitLinear, proving additivity by map_add and restricted scalar linearity by map_mul. Its value formula is reflexive. Construct scalarTensorCoefficientApp by tensorLift of tmulSection; its four bilinear laws are the tensor-section additivity and scalar laws. Tensor extensionality and tmulSection_map prove naturality. Form the presheaf morphism and extend it along the sheafification adjunction, using Sheaf.tensorLeftIso for the tensor source. The sectionwise formula remains the named characterization theorem exists_scalarTensorCoefficient. Other comparison constructions are unchanged and remain unrepaired.

K1 partial proof: scalarRestriction_id and scalarRestriction_comp follow by ModuleCat extensionality and the presheaf identity/composition laws. scalarHom_linear is the section map linearity applied to scalarMap f U r. scalarHom_naturality is PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply after extensionality. scalarHom_id, scalarHom_comp and scalarFunctor_additive are sectionwise definitional equalities. The other 17 named obligations remain open; all constructions and interfaces are unchanged.

H3 partial proof: scalarRestriction_linear follows from the module restriction scalar law and composition of the structure-ring maps. scalarPresheaf_isSheaf follows by forgetting to abelian groups and reflecting sheafhood. scalarFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits follows from sectionwise evaluation and restriction of scalars, then reflection by sheafToPresheaf. The inverse-image functor is additive by its adjunction to additive pushforward; left Kan extension along the flat opens map and sheafification preserve finite limits; the left adjunction preserves finite colimits. Tensoring on the left preserves finite limits sectionwise over the field, followed by sheafification and Sheaf.tensorLeftIso; monoidal closedness gives finite colimits. The braiding transfers these results to right tensoring. The tensor coefficient formula follows from the sheafification adjunction, the monoidal tensor comparison and evaluation on a pure tensor. Six existing named obligations remain open: exists_moduleExtEquiv, exists_scalarPullbackCoefficient, scalarCohomologyExtMap_add, scalarCohomologyExtMap_bijective, scalarCohomologyExtMap_smul, scalarFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits. All statements and definition bodies are unchanged.

U3 decomposition: for a fixed injective resolution, use moduleResolutionHomologyExtEquiv. Choose one resolution and transport this equivalence along isoRightDerivedObj. For another resolution, descend the identity into the chosen resolution; cyclesMap_i and homologyπ_naturality identify representatives, isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality identifies the derived-functor classes, and extMk_comp_mk₀ with comp_mk₀_id identifies Ext classes. The finite-colimit forgetful helper uses the restriction/coextension adjunction and sheafification comparison; the additive proof uses composition of additive homomorphisms. For exists_scalarPullbackCoefficient, restrict the normalized tensor-pullback unit sectionwise to k; naturality of scalarMap along the morphism over Spec k proves scalar linearity. Apply the inverse sheaf adjunction, whose apply_symm_apply identity proves the required formula. Scalar linearity and bijectivity remain unchanged obligations. Existing comparison data and signatures are preserved; the AddEquiv constructor is written directly with Equiv.ofBijective and its additive law.

C3: Prove scalarCohomologyExtMap_smul without assuming bijectivity. Construct the structure-sheaf endomorphism whose action on an open is multiplication by scalarMap f U r; functoriality of ring restriction gives its naturality. The constant-sheaf adjunction, evaluated on the terminal open, identifies scalarUnitMorphism followed by this endomorphism with its r-multiple. Choose an Ext cocycle in an injective module resolution. The characterization of moduleExtEquiv identifies a with the derived homology class of the cocycle. Homology projection and isoRightDerivedObj are global-section-module-linear, so multiplication of the cycle by scalarMap f top r represents r times a. Evaluation at 1 identifies its cocycle map with precomposition by the constructed endomorphism. InjectiveResolution.mk₀_comp_extMk identifies this with Ext precomposition. Finally a proved generic Ext identity combines mapExactFunctor_comp, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, associativity, mk₀_comp_mk₀, mk₀_smul and smul_comp. This establishes field linearity. The existing scalarCohomologyExtMap_bijective obligation remains untouched.

T4 reduction of the last obligation, scalarCohomologyExtMap_bijective: identify maps from the structure sheaf with global sections by evaluation at 1, with inverse given by restrictions and scalar multiplication. Evaluation at 1 also identifies linear maps from k with vector-space sections. The constant-sheaf adjunction and constantScalarUnitIso show that this Hom bijection is precisely precomposition by scalarUnitMorphism after scalarFunctor. Identify scalarFunctor with terminal-open restriction followed by field restriction using restrictScalarsComp'App. The fieldScalarRestriction_preservesInjectives theorem supplies preservation of injectives. A private generic induction on Ext degree now applies: degree zero is the Hom bijection via mk₀; for the successor, embed the coefficient in an injective, apply both covariant long exact sequences, and use the surjective/bijective right-exact five-lemma. mapExactFunctor_comp, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, mapExactFunctor_extClass and Ext associativity give the commuting squares. Finally compose this bijection with the existing moduleExtEquiv. The only new hole is injective preservation, strictly below the Ext comparison. All existing signatures and definitions are unchanged.

U3 stage-3: resolution-comparison glue using Mathlib injective-resolution and Ext APIs; fixed-resolution sections-to-Ext comparison split off. C3 stage-3: proved restricted-field linearity by an explicit scalar endomorphism, the constant-sheaf adjunction, the recorded cocycle characterization, and a generic Ext composition identity.
